full_name: Mei Zhen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Biological Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow University of Toronto (Canada)
bio: Mei Zhen, a professor at the University of Toronto and senior investigator at the Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute, Mount Sinai Hospital, is fascinated by how specific movement patterns are generated by animals. In her recent work, through an elegant combination of optogenetics and physiology tools, she has begun to dissect how animals generate and regulate their movements through a network of neurons and their connections.
